MatrixFont: Font used to draw text on the matrix.
MatrixFontSize: Integer scale applied to a text font.
MatrixModuleType: Physical size of one matrix module.
MatrixOrigin: Physical corner where the data chain starts.
MatrixScanAxis: Primary direction followed by the data chain.
sarduMatrix.Matrix.clear: Clears the RGB buffer and immediately updates the physical display.
sarduMatrix.Matrix.clearBuffer: Clears only the RGB buffer. Call show to update the physical display.
sarduMatrix.Matrix.drawText: Draws static text at explicit coordinates without showing it.
sarduMatrix.Matrix.drawTextCentered: Draws static text centered both horizontally and vertically.
sarduMatrix.Matrix.drawTextCenteredArea: Draws text centered inside the inclusive rectangle delimited by A and B.
sarduMatrix.Matrix.drawTextCenteredHeigh: Draws static text centered across the matrix height at an explicit X coordinate.
Draws text vertically centered between two inclusive Y coordinates.
sarduMatrix.Matrix.drawTextCenteredWidth: Draws static text centered across the matrix width at an explicit Y coordinate.
Draws text horizontally centered between two inclusive X coordinates.
sarduMatrix.Matrix.interruptAndClear: Stops long-running output, clears the RGB buffer and immediately updates the display.
sarduMatrix.Matrix.ledCount: Returns the number of configured RGB LEDs.
sarduMatrix.Matrix.rgbBufferBytes: Returns the exact size of the NeoPixel RGB buffer in bytes.
sarduMatrix.Matrix.scrollText: Scrolls one line left from the selected X and Y coordinates, then leaves the display black.
sarduMatrix.Matrix.setBrightness: Sets brightness for pixels written after this call.
sarduMatrix.Matrix.setPixel: Sets one logical pixel. Call show to update the physical display.
sarduMatrix.Matrix.show: Sends the RGB buffer to the physical display.
sarduMatrix.create: Creates one matrix using its total logical width and height.
sarduMatrix.createAdvanced: Creates one matrix with an explicitly configured physical pixel path.
sarduMatrix.createModules: Creates a horizontal row of identical matrix modules.
sarduMatrix.createModulesAdvanced: Creates a rectangular grid of modules with explicit physical paths.
sarduMatrix.hslColor: Creates a color using hue, saturation and HSL lightness.
sarduMatrix.measureFontHeight: Returns the rendered height of the selected font and size.
sarduMatrix.measureTextWidth: Returns the rendered width of a string for the selected font and size.
sarduMatrix.rgbColor: Creates a color from red, green and blue components.
sarduMatrixInternal.pathIndex: Maps a logical coordinate to a position in one physical scan path.
sarduMatrixInternal.physicalIndex: Maps a display coordinate to its LED position.
